fixtureGoal: Capture rollback approver, migration direction, SQL artifact reference, and production database boundary evidence before a release approval decision rehearsal.

requiredEvidenceFields.name: rollback-approver
requiredEvidenceFields.description: Operator records the human role or person allowed to approve rollback for the release window.

requiredEvidenceFields.name: database-migration-direction
requiredEvidenceFields.description: Operator records whether migration state is forward-only, rollback-script-reviewed, or no-database-change.

requiredEvidenceFields.name: rollback-sql-artifact-reference
requiredEvidenceFields.description: Operator records a reference to reviewed SQL artifacts or an explicit no-op statement; SQL text is not embedded.

requiredEvidenceFields.name: production-database-access-boundary
requiredEvidenceFields.description: Operator confirms this fixture does not connect to or require a production database.

requiredEvidenceFields.name: rollback-sql-review-gate
requiredEvidenceFields.description: Operator confirms the SQL review gate used before rollback SQL can be considered outside this fixture.

requiredEvidenceFields.name: no-secret-value-boundary
requiredEvidenceFields.description: Operator confirms this evidence stores metadata only and never embeds secret values.

noSecretValueBoundaries: Rollback approver fixture stores metadata only
Secret values must not be read by Java or Node when rendering this evidence
Secret values must not be embedded in rollback approver evidence JSON
Node may render decision rehearsal input only
forbiddenOperations: Creating a real approval decision from this fixture
Writing approval ledger entries from this fixture
Executing Java rollback from this fixture
Executing database rollback SQL from this fixture
Connecting production database from this fixture
Reading production secret values from this fixture
Embedding secret values in rollback approver evidence JSON
